user journey

01

underground

where you become intellectually dangerous.

uncover a living world of buried artifacts, rare books, and suppressed ideas — all human made.*

publish your own 'routes' to intellectual destinations.

teach a cohort learning sesh based on syllabi you design.

02

the cyph

where ideas get tested in real time.

spark with thinkers around the world in real time. go deeper in office hours with underground scholars.

03

irl

close the laptop and enter our world of IRL cyphs: lectures, office hours, supper clubs, & debates. the research from the room is archived in our partner libraries.

our last cyph...

in the room

10+ residential libraries in nyc where cyph members can check out books.
04

how it all maps together

everything on cyph has its own dna. map the influence, and intersections of your ideas over time with the cyphcard.
